notes.title: Internal Milestone Update #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added draft of levels 1 through 11 to the main menu
[*] Added new enemies to certain levels in the game
[*] Added penultimate texture and modelling pass to the cockpit
[*] Added item indicator to the object that will be picked up
[*] Fixed issue causing DLSS to be activated even on GPUs that don't support it
[*] Fixed issue where tutorial wouldn't boot
[*] Balance pass to steering in-game (not final)
[*] Balance pass to some systems in the cockpit
[*] Performance improvements
[*] First launch now forces you to play tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: New Level for people to try out
notes.content:
We've just enabled a new level (Level 4b) and we'd love people's feedback on it!

There's also a bunch of other general improvements and bug fixes, such as:
[list]
[*] New VFX when you hit something with the hammer
[*] Fix the bug where sometimes you would fire and a bullet wouldn't come out
[*] Even more jiggly physics when you pick up Ziggy
[*] Turrets are no longer 100% accurate, which should make level 2a slightly easier
[/list]
